scope: Named EF/error-feedback citation chain identified by the source paper and the Phase 16 cross-model audit

allowed_examples: we derive an explicit fixed-average factorization
we show that proportional regularity heterogeneity leaves the inherited cubic unchanged
we establish a conditional largest-root sensitivity result for the inherited cubic

N1a.summary: K1-K2 = Var_w(q_i) is an exact rewrite of inherited Empirical Law 4.3 coefficients.

N1b.summary: The fixed-(L_bar,mu_bar) factorization in (kappa_bar,tau_L,tau_mu), including the (tau_L-tau_mu)^2 factor, has no equivalent in the closed named source chain.

N2.summary: No named source-chain paper states an equivalent proportional-heterogeneity invariance for the inherited cubic.

N3.summary: No named source-chain paper proves d rho*/dK1 > 0 for this inherited cubic coordinate. Generic root/spectral monotonicity techniques are prior art and must not be claimed as new.

N4.summary: No named source-chain paper supplies the generic discriminant/root-location certificate for Empirical Law 4.3. Polynomial root-location techniques themselves are not claimed as new.

sources.citation: Thomsen, Taylor, Dieuleveut (2026), A Tight Theory of Error Feedback Algorithms in Distributed Optimization, arXiv:2605.31594
sources.regularity_structure: Simultaneous local L_i and mu_i appear in the inherited n=2 empirical law.
sources.overlap: Defines K1, K2, and the cubic; does not provide the Phase 12 fixed-average factorization or Phase 13 generic root-sensitivity certificate.

sources.citation: Zheng, Huang, Kwok (2019), Communication-Efficient Distributed Blockwise Momentum SGD with Error-Feedback, arXiv:1905.10936
sources.regularity_structure: Nonconvex distributed SGD; Assumption 1 uses a single global L-smooth objective F and no local strong-convexity constants mu_i.
sources.overlap: No simultaneous local (L_i,mu_i) regularity mismatch, no K1/K2 cubic, no N1b-N4 equivalent.

sources.citation: Li and Li (2022/2023), Analysis of Error Feedback in Federated Non-Convex Optimization with Biased Compression, arXiv:2211.14292 / ICML 2023
sources.regularity_structure: Nonconvex federated optimization with data heterogeneity and partial participation; no simultaneous local strong-convexity constants mu_i.
sources.overlap: Data heterogeneity/stale error compensation, not paired local regularity mismatch or cubic root structure.

sources.citation: Tang, Li, Liu, Yan (2021), ErrorCompensatedX: error compensation for variance reduced algorithms, arXiv:2108.02102
sources.regularity_structure: Variance-reduced distributed learning/error compensation; the variance object is stochastic-gradient history rather than local regularity dispersion.
sources.overlap: No K1/K2, no fixed-average (L_i,mu_i) factorization, no inherited cubic sensitivity result.

sources.citation: Fatkhullin, Tyurin, Richtarik (2023), Momentum Provably Improves Error Feedback!, arXiv:2305.15155
sources.regularity_structure: Canonical stochastic nonconvex setting with smoothness and bounded variance assumptions; no simultaneous local mu_i regularity family.

sources.citation: Condat, Yi, Richtarik (2022), EF-BV: A Unified Theory of Error Feedback and Variance Reduction Mechanisms for Biased and Unbiased Compression in Distributed Optimization, arXiv:2205.04180
sources.regularity_structure: Unifies biased/unbiased compressor parameters and variance reduction; its variance parameters belong to the compressor/randomness mechanism.
sources.overlap: No weighted variance of q_i=(L_i-mu_i)/(L_i+mu_i), no aligned regularity invariance, no Empirical-Law-4.3 cubic analysis.

sources.citation: Fatkhullin, Sokolov, Gorbunov, Li, Richtarik (2025), EF21 with Bells & Whistles: Six Algorithmic Extensions of Modern Error Feedback, JMLR 26(189), arXiv:2110.03294
sources.regularity_structure: Smooth nonconvex and PL regimes supporting partial participation, stochastic approximation, variance reduction, proximal, momentum, and bidirectional compression; no paired local mu_i regularity mismatch coordinate identified.
sources.overlap: Algorithmic extensions and rate bounds, not N1b-N4.

sources.citation: Gao, Islamov, Stich (2023), EControl: Fast Distributed Optimization with Compression and Error Control, arXiv:2311.05645
sources.regularity_structure: Allows local smoothness constants L_i, but strong convexity is imposed only on the average objective f with a single global mu; individual f_i may even be nonconvex.
sources.overlap: Strong evidence that EControl does not instantiate simultaneous local (L_i,mu_i) regularity heterogeneity required for N1b-N2.

sources.citation: Gruntkowska, Gaponov, Tovmasyan, Richtarik (2025/2026), Error Feedback for Muon and Friends, arXiv:2510.00643 / ICLR 2026
sources.regularity_structure: Non-Euclidean smooth and (L0,L1)-smooth regimes, including layer-wise generalized smoothness; not simultaneous Euclidean local (L_i,mu_i) strong-convexity heterogeneity.
sources.overlap: Different geometry and optimizer family; no N1b-N4 equivalent.

sources.citation: Egger, Bitar, Wachter-Zeh, Weinberger, Gunduz (2025), BICompFL: Stochastic Federated Learning with Bi-Directional Compression, arXiv:2502.00206
sources.regularity_structure: Stochastic/Bayesian federated learning and communication-cost analysis; not EF21 local regularity-parameter heterogeneity.
sources.overlap: No K1/K2 or cubic regularity-mismatch structure.

sources.citation: Redie, Arablouei, Werner (2026), SA-PEF: Step-Ahead Partial Error Feedback for Efficient Federated Learning, arXiv:2601.20738 / TMLR 2026
sources.regularity_structure: Nonconvex objectives, data heterogeneity, partial participation, and a residual contraction factor controlled by a step-ahead parameter; no local strong-convexity family mu_i.
sources.overlap: Its rho_r is a residual recursion quantity, not the inherited Empirical Law 4.3 largest cubic root rho_star.

sources.citation: Tian, Li, Liu, Shi (2026), EF21-RR: Fast O(1/T) rate for non-convex federated optimization with error feedback, Automatica 183:112655
sources.regularity_structure: Nonconvex stochastic federated optimization with a global PL extension; no simultaneous local (L_i,mu_i) regularity family.
sources.overlap: Rate/sample-efficiency result, not N1b-N4 algebraic or cubic-root prior art.

closure_result.interpretation: The named source-paper citation chain no longer contains an unresolved candidate that matches N1b-N4 at the stated theorem/equation level. This is not a proof of universal novelty outside the named chain.

remaining_guardrails: Treat N1a as inherited algebraic interpretation only.
Cite Thomsen-Taylor-Dieuleveut as the source of K1, K2, and the cubic.
Do not claim root-location, Jury/Routh, discriminant, or implicit-function techniques themselves are new.
Do not use first/novel/no-prior-work language without a stronger bibliographic claim audit.
The quarantined cross-model [[ef21-stability-analysis]] reference remains unusable until a concrete source is located.
